examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The band as the home page places it: the `artwork` layout with the overline, headline and lead over two picture tiles in the four-column frame. Edit the props in the Controls panel — a band with no tiles renders nothing at all, and one with no title drops its header.

examples.name: Types
examples.summary: Both layouts stacked: the `artwork` band with its header and picture tiles in the four-column frame with marks on every corner, then the `illustrated` band with no header, an `anchor`, and three illustration tiles in the three-column frame with marks on the bottom rule.

site.name: Artwork
site.summary: The Why Azion band: an eyebrow, a title and a description over four tiles, each picture an image URL.

site.name: Illustrated
site.summary: The Pricing band: three tiles with no heading, each picture a registered illustration scaled per tile.
